title: The Camunda cohort was screened on six dimensions, only one of which is Camunda depth
content:
This group records a screening lens rather than a claim about a company. The six dimensions applied to the Camunda cohort were: public-sector documentation, sovereignty access, Camunda depth, on-premises posture, OSS or AGPL licensing, and co-build size. Keeping it in the vault preserves how the cohort was ranked, which is otherwise invisible once only the resulting priorities remain.

Read as a rubric it says something non-obvious about the qualification: Camunda depth is one criterion of six. Partner status alone does not rank a lead. Sovereignty access and open-source licensing carry comparable weight, and co-build size acts as a feasibility gate — a lead can be a strong technical fit and still fail because a joint build is not viable at its scale.

The four leads it is recorded against are Devapo, Incentro, adesso SE and msg systems ag, in UK, NL and DE, and they arrived through the verified "v5 · Camunda cohort" source rather than the unverified one. Three ended at "9 · do not pitch" and one at "3 · later". The lens is the reusable artefact here; the outcomes for these four are not evidence that the lens is right, only that it was applied.
